reason: We have always washed by hand at the tap and it works fine for us. Without steady power the borewell often isn't running anyway, so a machine that finishes its load on battery doesn't fix my real water problem.
objection: Why spend twenty-two thousand on a machine we've never needed? And if I ever wanted one, my inverter could run an ordinary washer, or I could just get a bigger inverter that also runs the fans and lights.
would_change_my_mind: If my daughter-in-law or a neighbour I trust used one for months through the power cuts, and it could run off a filled tank or drum without needing the pump, I might think about it for the household.
